card.name: Subject before 'call' in 'what X calls'
card.fires_on: The subject (or word just before the verb) in a 'what/which [someone] calls ...' phrase, right where the verb 'call' is expected next. It marks a coined or named term introduced by a person or group.

modes.label: Subject after 'what'
modes.description: A pronoun or name directly after 'what' or 'which', before 'call/calls/called'.
modes.example: during what<< he>> calls the second phase of the industrial revolution

modes.label: Modal or comma before call
modes.description: A modal word or comma sitting between the subject and the verb 'call'.
modes.example: in what Meyer<< might>> call the problem-creating phase

modes.label: Group noun as subject
modes.description: A plural or group noun such as officials or geologists that precedes 'call' and a quoted term.
modes.example: what SEED<< officials>> call the "Socratic method" of

card.writes: It promotes the verb 'call' and its forms, so the model predicts 'call' next.
card.plain: It fires when a text is about to say 'what someone calls' a named idea, and predicts the word 'call'.
